title: Everyday Phrases — Asking for a Pay Rise
title_quote: Can we talk about my salary?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】💼 實用「談加薪」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Asking for a Pay Rise
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「談加薪」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是主管：跟主管談加薪：先約好時間、把這一年的成果整理成清單，說明自己完成了什麼、帶來什麼數字，主管問期望金額、提到預算與時程，最後談成調整方向與時間點，寫進考核並道謝。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Asking for a Pay Rise' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). Asking for a pay rise: booking a meeting, presenting a year of results, discussing the expected figure, working around a frozen budget, and agreeing on a timeline. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we talk about my salary?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以談談我的薪水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us meet on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When are you free this week?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My schedule is very full.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How about Thursday afternoon at three?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday works, but not at three.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you busy on Thursday morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have a meeting then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we meet before the standup?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在站立會議前見面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, ten minutes is enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have time on Friday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday morning is open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time suits you best?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right after lunch works for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I book the small room?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small room is quiet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your calendar open on Monday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, Monday is already packed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I put thirty minutes aside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, thirty minutes should be fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who should join our talk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just you and me, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is this week so busy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The audit deadline is on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we meet on Zoom instead?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以改在 Zoom 見嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zoom is easier for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is your office again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the fifth floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would Tuesday at two work?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesday at two is perfect.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us keep it short today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, twenty minutes is enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Friday afternoon still free?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a client visit came up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will our meeting take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About half an hour, I hope.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you prefer morning or afternoon?
dialogue.zh: 你比較喜歡早上還是下午？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning is better for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I send you a calendar invite?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ sɛnd ju ə ˈkæləndər ɪnˈvaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以寄行事曆邀請給你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please send it today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you free right after lunch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that slot is open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about Wednesday at ten?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wednesday morning is fully booked.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we meet near the cafeteria?
dialogue.zh: 我們在咖啡廳附近見嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the cafeteria is quiet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you be in tomorrow morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I work from home tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for making time for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, this talk is important.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have last year's numbers?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are in this folder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you save the report?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saved it on the shared drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ seɪvd ɪt ɑn ðə ʃɛrd draɪv/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many clients did we sign?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We signed twelve new clients.
dialogue.zh: 我們簽下十二個新客戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you print the sales chart?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will print two copies.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I highlight first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with the revenue growth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the budget sheet ready?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I updated it this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these figures correct?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, our finance team checked them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who prepared this summary page?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wrote it last Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we add the client quotes?
dialogue.zh: 我們該加上客戶評語嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they make it stronger.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the presentation?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It takes about ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a printed handout?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a digital copy is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is the deadline for this?
dialogue.zh: 這件事的截止日是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The deadline is next Wednesday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I borrow your laptop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the battery is full.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this chart too crowded?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but the labels are small.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we meet the target this year?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi mit ðə ˈtɑrɡɪt ðɪs jɪr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We passed it in October.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What number should I memorize?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Remember the twenty percent growth.
dialogue.zh: 記住百分之二十的成長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you check my spelling?
dialogue.zh: 你可以幫我檢查拼字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will read it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are the old invoices?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are in the bottom drawer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do we need two versions?
dialogue.zh: 我們為什麼需要兩個版本？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The manager likes a short one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us finish this before lunch.
dialogue.zh: 我們在午餐前完成這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, we are almost done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you saved the final file?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I saved it twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the printer be free soon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is free right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I include the survey results?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They support your case.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many pages is it now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is only four pages long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for helping me prepare.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, your data looks strong.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，你的資料很有力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I finished the client project in June.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə ˈklaɪənt ˈprɑdʒɛkt ɪn dʒun/
dialogue.zh: 我在六月完成了客戶專案。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was a big win.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three new teammates learned from me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That saved the team time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We launched the new app in March.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi lɔntʃt ðə nu æp ɪn mɑrtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我們三月推出新應用程式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It reached many users fast.
dialogue.zh: 它很快觸及很多使用者。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I handled the complaints alone.
dialogue.zh: 我獨自處理了那些客訴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was very hard work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you lead the Monday workshop?
dialogue.zh: 你主持週一的研討會嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I led it every week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My team cut costs by ten percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tim kʌt kɔsts baɪ tɛn pərˈsɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 我的團隊把成本降低一成。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a real improvement.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The training guide was my idea.
dialogue.zh: 那份訓練手冊是我的主意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New hires use it every day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This year I solved many problems.
dialogue.zh: 今年我解決了很多問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give me one clear example.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We shipped the update before summer.
dialogue.zh: 我們在夏天前推出更新。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Customers stopped complaining after that.
dialogue.zh: 之後客戶就不再抱怨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I visited five branches last quarter.
dialogue.zh: 我上一季跑了五個分店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That must have been tiring.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has the report been sent out?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I sent it yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Were you in charge of billing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I was in charge of support.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪ wʌz ɪn tʃɑrdʒ əv səˈpɔrt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our response time improved a lot.
dialogue.zh: 我們的反應時間改善很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much faster is it now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The new process is much faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Numbers please, not just words.
dialogue.zh: 請給數字，不要只是說法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two junior designers learned from me.
dialogue.zh: 兩個初階設計師跟我學習。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did they stay with the company?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We won the regional service award.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is worth mentioning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I automated the weekly sales report.
dialogue.zh: 我把每週銷售報告自動化了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That saves hours every week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please look at my project list.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will read it tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, may I add one more point?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri meɪ aɪ æd wʌn mɔr pɔɪnt?/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我可以再補一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the data show real growth?
dialogue.zh: 資料顯示真的有成長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, every quarter went up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The old website is fixed now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That helped our online sales.
dialogue.zh: 那幫助了我們的線上銷售。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We kept every deadline this year.
dialogue.zh: 我們今年守住了每個截止日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a strong record.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My client renewals reached ninety percent.
dialogue.zh: 我的客戶續約率達到九成。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That number speaks for itself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want to look at the numbers?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, show me the summary page.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for listening to all this.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a solid year of work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə ˈsɑlɪd jɪr əv wɜrk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Revenue grew twenty percent this year.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That beats our original plan.
dialogue.zh: 那超過我們原本的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We added twelve new clients.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve clients is a great result.
dialogue.zh: 十二個客戶是很棒的成果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Costs dropped by ten percent.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That helped the whole department.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Response time fell to two hours.
dialogue.zh: 反應時間縮短到兩小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Customers noticed the difference.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these numbers audited yet?
dialogue.zh: 這些數字已經審核過了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, finance signed them off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our team saved ten hours weekly.
dialogue.zh: 我們團隊每週省下十小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is almost a full day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I brought in three big contracts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those contracts changed our year.
dialogue.zh: 那些合約改變了我們這一年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else should I mention?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mention the ninety percent renewal rate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the growth number final?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it will not change.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The survey gave us high scores.
dialogue.zh: 問卷給我們很高的分數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What score did customers give?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They gave us nine out of ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɡeɪv ʌs naɪn aʊt əv tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 他們給了我們十分裡的九分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is rare in this company.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these results deserve a raise?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they deserve a serious talk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I ask for eight percent?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, eight percent sounds fair.
dialogue.zh: 該，百分之八聽起來合理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which number impresses you most?
dialogue.zh: 哪個數字最讓你印象深刻？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The twelve new clients impress me.
dialogue.zh: 十二個新客戶讓我印象深刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My overtime hours stayed low.
dialogue.zh: 我的加班時數一直很低。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That shows good planning too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would a short summary help you?
dialogue.zh: 一頁摘要對你有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one page is enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The team hit every quarterly target.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is four quarters in a row.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz fɔr ˈkwɔrtərz ɪn ə roʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you seen the final figures?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I checked them last night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us compare this year with last.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs kəmˈpɛr ðɪs jɪr wɪð læst/
dialogue.zh: 我們把今年跟去年比一比。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gap is clearly visible.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you support my request?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your record is strong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is this year different?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We finally have the numbers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you say that again slowly?
dialogue.zh: 你可以慢慢再說一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the growth is twenty percent.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This quarter was our best one.
dialogue.zh: 這季是我們最好的一季。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It really was an amazing quarter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These numbers tell a clear story.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let us show them together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for your support today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You earned this conversation.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we talk about my pay?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以談談我的薪水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let us sit down here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What number do you have in mind?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈnʌmbər du ju hæv ɪn maɪnd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am thinking about a small raise.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ə smɔl reɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我在想一個小幅度加薪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you tell me your expected range?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju tɛl mi jʊr ɪkˈspɛktɪd reɪndʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 可以告訴我你期望的範圍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My range is open for discussion.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there room in the budget?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is some room this year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can we review my salary?
dialogue.zh: 我們什麼時候可以檢視我的薪水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can review it next round.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much do you expect this time?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ du ju ɪkˈspɛkt ðɪs taɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I expect a fair and clear number.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɪkˈspɛkt ə fɛr ænd klɪr ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 我期望一個公平清楚的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have any number ready?
dialogue.zh: 你有準備好任何數字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, but I can prepare one.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt bʌt aɪ kæn prɪˈpɛr wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 還沒，但我可以準備一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the total look like now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ðə ˈtoʊtəl lʊk laɪk naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The total is still under review.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we set a clear timeline?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以訂一個清楚的時程嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can start next period.
dialogue.zh: 我們下一期就可以開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the budget come from?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It comes from the team fund.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you support my request today?
dialogue.zh: 你今天會支持我的請求嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will support it fully.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I write the number down?
dialogue.zh: 我應該把數字寫下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please write it on this form.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who decides the final amount?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The head office decides it later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the process so slow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It takes time to approve changes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we close to an answer?
dialogue.zh: 我們快要得到答案了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are close, but not yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could the raise start in three months?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ðə reɪz stɑrt ɪn θri mʌnθs?/
dialogue.zh: 加薪可以三個月後開始嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It starts after the budget freeze.
dialogue.zh: 預算凍結結束後才開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I put in my note?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ʃʊd aɪ pʊt ɪn maɪ noʊt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put your duties and your results.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the numbers match my record?
dialogue.zh: 這些數字和我的紀錄一致嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They match the record I have.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will the review take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will take a short while.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask for a small change?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk fɔr ə smɔl tʃeɪndʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以要求小幅調整嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a small change is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the form ready for signing?
dialogue.zh: 表格準備好可以簽了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The form is ready on my desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɔrm ɪz ˈrɛdi ɑn maɪ dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 表格在我桌上準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the plan include a review?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the plan includes one review.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you sign the form today?
dialogue.zh: 你今天可以簽這張表嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will sign it after lunch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for hearing me out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are welcome, and well prepared.
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，你準備得很充分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us keep this talk private.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, this stays between us.
dialogue.zh: 當然，只有我們兩個人知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The budget is frozen right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is hard news for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My request may wait a few months.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ rɪˈkwɛst meɪ weɪt ə fju mʌnθs/
dialogue.zh: 我的請求可能要等幾個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the freeze should end soon.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，凍結應該快結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can plan for the next cycle.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn plæn fɔr ðə nɛkst ˈsaɪkəl/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以為下一個週期做規劃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sounds fair and very clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the freeze a long one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It should last three more months.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is no room in the fund.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz noʊ rum ɪn ðə fʌnd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we must wait a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This period is closed for changes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I understand, but I feel disappointed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That news is not what I hoped.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt nuz ɪz nɑt wʌt aɪ hoʊpt/
dialogue.zh: 這消息不是我所希望的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, and I am sorry too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ænd aɪ æm ˈsɑri tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After the freeze, can we talk again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər ðə friz kæn wi tɔk əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 凍結結束後，我們可以再談嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can talk next round.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we can set a later date.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi wi kæn sɛt ə ˈleɪtər deɪt/
dialogue.zh: 也許我們可以訂晚一點的日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A later date works well for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈleɪtər deɪt wɜrks wɛl fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 晚一點的日期對我沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perhaps the review can wait a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /pərˈhæps ðə rɪˈvju kæn weɪt ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 也許考核可以再等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, but I need a clear plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn bʌt aɪ nid ə klɪr plæn/
dialogue.zh: 好，但我需要清楚的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, the funds are all frozen.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，經費全都被凍結了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hear you, and I understand why.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr ju ænd aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd waɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我聽進去了，也了解原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for telling me the truth.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You deserve a clear and honest answer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪˈzɜrv ə klɪr ænd ˈɑnɪst ˈænsər/
dialogue.zh: 你值得一個清楚誠實的答案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please keep my request on file.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will keep it on file.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our team still needs the support.
dialogue.zh: 我們團隊仍然需要支持。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your work is not forgotten here.
dialogue.zh: 你的付出在這裡沒有被忘記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your honesty means a lot to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈɑnɪsti minz ə lɑt tu mi/
dialogue.zh: 你的誠實對我意義重大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honesty is the only fair way.
dialogue.zh: 誠實是唯一公平的做法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All the changes must wait a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ðə ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz mʌst weɪt ə waɪl/
dialogue.zh: 所有變更都得先等一等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can wait for a clear plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn weɪt fɔr ə klɪr plæn/
dialogue.zh: 只要有清楚計畫我可以等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more quarter is not too long.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ˈkwɔrtər ɪz nɑt tu lɔŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a fair point.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just tell me when the freeze ends.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tɛl mi wɛn ðə friz ɛndz/
dialogue.zh: 只要告訴我凍結什麼時候結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It ends when the new quarter starts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɛndz wɛn ðə nu ˈkwɔrtər stɑrts/
dialogue.zh: 新的一季開始時就結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the raise starts next quarter?
dialogue.zh: 所以加薪從下一季開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if the budget opens again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But I have done extra work.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, and I wrote it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ænd aɪ roʊt ɪt daʊn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we should set a new date.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi ʃʊd sɛt ə nu deɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我們應該訂個新日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us mark it on the plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs mɑrk ɪt ɑn ðə plæn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I feel a little better.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we will keep it moving.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Later we can check the total again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪtər wi kæn tʃɛk ðə ˈtoʊtəl əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 之後我們可以再看一次總數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That works, and I will remind you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɜrks ænd aɪ wɪl rɪˈmaɪnd ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the freeze cover every team?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It covers the whole office here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡整個辦公室都涵蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we try again next quarter?
dialogue.zh: 我們下一季可以再試一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, next quarter is the right time.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs nɛkst ˈkwɔrtər ɪz ðə raɪt taɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If the amount changes, tell me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will tell you the same day.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tɛl ju ðə seɪm deɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can accept a smaller change.
dialogue.zh: 我可以接受小一點的調整。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a fair and kind offer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə fɛr ænd kaɪnd ˈɔfər/
dialogue.zh: 這是個公平又善意的提議。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can adjust the start date.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the start date moves forward.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They will write it in the form.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɪl raɪt ɪt ɪn ðə fɔrm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the form keeps it official.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can split the change later.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以稍後把調整拆開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Splitting it is fine with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the new date in writing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will note it in writing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me a clear and honest answer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi ə klɪr ænd ˈɑnɪst ˈænsər/
dialogue.zh: 給我一個清楚誠實的答案。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The answer is yes for next quarter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈænsər ɪz jɛs fɔr nɛkst ˈkwɔrtər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the small raise for now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will take it and keep working.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl teɪk ɪt ænd kip ˈwɜrkɪŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write the plan on the form.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The form is on your desk now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɔrm ɪz ɑn jʊr dɛsk naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How about starting after the review?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That timing sounds right to me.
dialogue.zh: 這個時間點我覺得可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us agree on the new timing.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs əˈɡri ɑn ðə nu ˈtaɪmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我們就新的時間點達成共識。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I agree, and I will note it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ əˈɡri ænd aɪ wɪl noʊt ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The change is small but real.
dialogue.zh: 這個調整雖小但是實際的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A real change is worth waiting for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ril tʃeɪndʒ ɪz wɜrθ ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It will show up in my review.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl ʃoʊ ʌp ɪn maɪ rɪˈvju/
dialogue.zh: 這會出現在我的考核裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your review will mention it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should note the date clearly.
dialogue.zh: 我們應該把日期寫清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will note it in the review.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl noʊt ɪt ɪn ðə rɪˈvju/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please add the timeline to the form.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz æd ðə ˈtaɪmlaɪn tu ðə fɔrm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The timeline is added right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we make the change smaller?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以把調整變小嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a smaller change is possible.
dialogue.zh: 可以，小一點的調整是可行的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What part comes first for you?
dialogue.zh: 對你來說哪一部分先處理？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The title comes first, then the pay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaɪtəl kʌmz fɜrst ðɛn ðə peɪ/
dialogue.zh: 先處理職稱，再處理薪水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would a new title help my case?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ə nu ˈtaɪtəl hɛlp maɪ keɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 新的職稱對我的情況有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A new title helps your case.
dialogue.zh: 新職稱對你的情況有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the duties part of the deal?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈdutiz pɑrt əv ðə dil?/
dialogue.zh: 職責是協議的一部分嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are part of the same deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr pɑrt əv ðə seɪm dil/
dialogue.zh: 它們是同一份協議的一部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we keep the old start date?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi kip ði oʊld stɑrt deɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要保留原本的開始日期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the old date still works well.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ði oʊld deɪt stɪl wɜrks wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 要，原本的日期還是很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does the new change begin?
dialogue.zh: 新的調整什麼時候開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It begins right after the review.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we write this down?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it on the first page.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who will check the final plan?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The head office checks every plan.
dialogue.zh: 總公司會檢查每一份計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not start with the title change?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ nɑt stɑrt wɪð ðə ˈtaɪtəl tʃeɪndʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 何不先從職稱調整開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a good and simple step.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ɡʊd ænd ˈsɪmpəl stɛp/
dialogue.zh: 這是個好又簡單的步驟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the plan fair for both sides?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə plæn fɛr fɔr boʊθ saɪdz?/
dialogue.zh: 這個計畫對雙方公平嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, both sides can accept it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything is written in my review.
dialogue.zh: 一切都寫在我的考核裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I can see it here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing else is left to discuss.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we are all done today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something good came out of this talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɡʊd keɪm aʊt əv ðɪs tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 這次談話有了好的結果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am glad we talked it through.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ɡlæd wi tɔkt ɪt θru/
dialogue.zh: 我很高興我們把它談清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone will notice the change soon.
dialogue.zh: 大家很快就會注意到這個調整。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The change will help the whole team.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃeɪndʒ wɪl hɛlp ðə hoʊl tim/
dialogue.zh: 這個調整會幫助整個團隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Together we found a fair answer.
dialogue.zh: 我們一起找到了公平的答案。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair answers keep the team strong.
dialogue.zh: 公平的答案讓團隊更強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The exact date is still open.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The timing will be clear next quarter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaɪmɪŋ wɪl bi klɪr nɛkst ˈkwɔrtər/
dialogue.zh: 時間點下一季就會清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, I want to say thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl aɪ wɑnt tu seɪ θæŋk ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are welcome, and you earned it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ˈwɛlkəm ænd ju ɜrnd ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even a small raise means a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ə smɔl reɪz minz ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 就算小幅加薪也很有意義。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small steps still move you forward.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Much of my work is now written.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌtʃ əv maɪ wɜrk ɪz naʊ ˈrɪtən/
dialogue.zh: 我的許多工作現在都寫進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is written on the right page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈrɪtən ɑn ðə raɪt peɪdʒ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Most of the plan looks clear now.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst əv ðə plæn lʊks klɪr naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 計畫大部分現在都清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plan is clear and fair.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best of all, the review is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst əv ɔl ðə rɪˈvju ɪz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 最棒的是考核已經完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finishing feels good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, that went better than I feared.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðæt wɛnt ˈbɛtər ðæn aɪ fɪrd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It went well because you prepared.
dialogue.zh: 因為你準備充分，所以很順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, I will wait one quarter.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your patience will be remembered.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, we have a deal for later.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wi hæv ə dil fɔr ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 好，我們就說定之後再談。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will keep my promise.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, the date is in the record.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ðə deɪt ɪz ɪn ðə ˈrɛkərd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，日期已經在紀錄裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The record will help us both.
dialogue.zh: 這份紀錄對我們雙方都有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finally, the talk is almost over.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We covered everything we needed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both of us want the same thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ əv ʌs wɑnt ðə seɪm θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我們雙方要的是同一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we both want fair work.
dialogue.zh: 對，我們都想要公平的待遇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, thank you for your time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are welcome, and good luck.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Each step is now clear and written.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ stɛp ɪz naʊ klɪr ænd ˈrɪtən/
dialogue.zh: 每個步驟現在都清楚寫下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clear steps make the work easier.
dialogue.zh: 清楚的步驟讓工作更容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready or not, the review starts soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi ɔr nɑt ðə rɪˈvju stɑrts sun/
dialogue.zh: 不管準備好沒，考核快開始了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am ready for the next step.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈrɛdi fɔr ðə nɛkst stɛp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am grateful for your support.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You earned it with hard work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks again for hearing me out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for being so clear.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你表達得這麼清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will keep doing my best work.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kip ˈduɪŋ maɪ bɛst wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 我會繼續把工作做到最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is all I can ask for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ɔl aɪ kæn æsk fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 這就是我能要求的全部了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we talk again next quarter?
dialogue.zh: 我們下一季可以再談嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, we will talk then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope the raise comes next quarter.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp ðə reɪz kʌmz nɛkst ˈkwɔrtər/
dialogue.zh: 我希望加薪下一季能實現。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope so too, and soon.
dialogue.zh: 我也希望，而且希望很快。

issues.note: 300–320 區間兩把聲音的「要求方／回應方」在相鄰對之間來回互換（304 a 授權、308 a 決定，隔幾對後 312 a 又變成請求方、314 a 又變回主管），單段內聽感上不易鎖定誰在談加薪；依 vbrief 聲部規則不算 error，屬遺留的清晰度問題。
352–353 已宣告「沒有別的要談／今天結束」，之後仍延續 46 行收尾（含 384、390、392、393 連續四句致謝），屬尾段偏長的重複收束，非 error。
192/193「Could you say that again slowly?」並無前句可重述，b 直接給新數字，銜接略空；另「Can we…」起句全篇約 7 次、「That is…」開頭的 b 句偏多，屬變化度殘留。

review.summary_zh: 本輪兩項指定修正已在最新視圖中確認：第 1 段 b 句以 Yes/No 起句降至約 9/25（其中純 Yes／No 僅 3／3，約 24–36%，已明顯低於半數）；第 3 段 quarter 類時間詞由 14 行降至 5 行（282／285／286／298／299），並改用 next round、next period、in three months、after the budget freeze；169→170 已補上數字「They gave us nine out of ten.」。全篇事實一致（二十％成長、十二位新客、九十％續約、成本降十％、凍結三個月約等於一季），無 error 級問題。C 項依機器證據給分（SUSPECT 0、逐詞 token 對齊通過）。驗收員未編輯任何內容。
